title: eval-harness: prompt-set regression gating and CI hooks for quality metrics
author: Ava Chen
description:
Motivation: Prevent accidental quality regressions from being merged by adding automated prompt-set regression checks and configurable quality gates into the eval-harness CI pipeline. This PR introduces a CI hook that runs targeted evals for changed prompts, computes per-prompt and aggregated metrics, and blocks merges when thresholds are breached.

What changed: implemented a new CI hook (eval-harness/ci/hooks/prompt_regression_hook.py) that: collects changed prompt sets, runs the eval harness in a deterministic mode, uploads metrics to the existing eval-metrics service, and evaluates against configurable gates (per-metric thresholds and per-prompt allowances). Added quality_gates.py that defines gate evaluation logic and an HTTP client for the metrics service. Added unit and integration tests, CI pipeline wiring (ci/pipeline/ci.yaml), and docs (docs/eval/ci-gates.md) with examples and configuration schema.

Configuration & usage: gates can be defined in repo-level .eval-gates.yaml or in repo settings via the console. Supported metrics: exact_match, rouge-l, mean_token_prob, hallucination_rate (pluggable). Gate modes: hard-fail (block merge), warn-only, and auto-approval with rollback hooks. The hook supports a dry-run mode for gradual rollout.

Testing & validation: Added unit tests for gate logic and a small in-memory integration test that simulates metrics upload failures and verifies retry/backoff behavior. CI pipeline runs evals on changed prompt sets only to keep run-time reasonable. We validated across canary repos and observed stable behavior with the canary thresholds.

Rollout plan: ship as opt-in initially (dry-run) and enable for internal infra repos first. Follow-up tasks: add dashboards for gate failures and automated Linear alerts (ENG-2345).

Checklist:
- [x] Implementation of gate evaluation logic
- [x] CI hook integration and pipeline changes
- [x] Tests (unit + integration)
- [x] Docs and example configs
- [x] Manual canary validation

Notes: This PR focuses on the CI- and eval-side gating. Future work will add tighter Console integrations and an RBAC toggle for gate enforcement.
